facts.value: Adapts the Breath/Sparky article's item event to shared interaction-reference cleanup. It forwards the article and reference object unchanged to it_8026B894 and discards the helper's Boolean result. The helper clears matching owner, reflector, absorber, fighter and toucher references; when xCEC_fighterGObj matches, it also sets xCB0_source_ply to 6. If the owner is cleared, the article's shared lifetime callback subsequently requests removal when invoked. The wrapper itself neither destroys the article nor identifies a specific visible gameplay trigger.
facts.rationale: The canonical shared helper supplies concrete cleanup semantics missing from the existing generic-event explanation, while the local lifetime callback establishes the consequence of owner loss. Preserve uncertainty about the event trigger.
